title: Comunicado 2026-09-08
summary: The BCCh Council unanimously held the policy rate at 4.5% and kept its meeting-by-meeting, data-dependent guidance with no directional bias, reaffirming the 3% two-year target. Versus the July communique, the balance of the text tilts slightly toward activity: July flagged an upside surprise in core inflation, rising short-term expectations and Fed-driven peso depreciation, whereas September reports core stable at 3.3% with the headline rise (4.1%) attributed to volatile items and fuel pass-through in line with history, a dollar that has weakened globally, and a domestic economy below the June IPoM with contracting consumption and investment, job destruction and higher unemployment. The risk section is now explicitly two-sided: the Middle East conflict has intensified again (oil near US$100), but the Council adds that the current weakness of the economy may prove more persistent than expected. There is no signal of a cut, so this remains a comfortable hold, marginally softer in tone than July.

key_quotes.quote: En su Reunión de Política Monetaria, el Consejo del Banco Central de Chile acordó mantener la tasa de interés de política monetaria en 4,5%. La decisión fue adoptada por la unanimidad de sus miembros.
key_quotes.context: Unanimous hold at 4.5%, as in July

key_quotes.quote: Por otro, si bien se anticipa que la economía local retomará impulso hacia 2027, no puede descartarse que su debilidad actual sea más persistente que lo previsto.
key_quotes.context: New downside activity risk added to the risk balance, absent in July

key_quotes.quote: En gran parte, la inflación ha continuado determinada por el alza del valor de los combustibles, cuyo traspaso a otros precios ha seguido los patrones históricos.
key_quotes.context: Headline rise read as fuel/volatile-driven; core stable at 3.3% vs July's upside core surprise

key_quotes.quote: De este modo, la evolución futura de la TPM seguirá evaluándose Reunión a Reunión en función del desarrollo de los acontecimientos.
